The model never changes; effort max is opt-in.","id":"gh:1368152838","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-model-router","slug":"Neptune810/dsh-model-router","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","reasoning-effort"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Flash-only reasoning-effort routing for DeepSeek Harness, setting the DeepSeek flash model reasoning"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" effort per step. The model never changes; effort max is opt-in."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-model-router"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that keeps a pool of
models and routes every step to one of them with its "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"reasoning effort set. Thinking stays on —
DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"contains a tool call made with thinking
off."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Routing table"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Step class | Decided by | Reasoning effort | Internal point |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| `trivial` | a clearly cheap intent (translate, rename, reformat) in a short step | `low` | ~50 |
|"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" `standard` | a plain short request with no engineering cue | `low` | ~50 |
| `engineering` | engine"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ering cues, code/diff/XML structure, or an agent tool loop | `high` | ~75 |
| `hard` | a dense engin"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"eering brief, or failures earned inside the task | `high` (`max` when `allowMax`) | ~75 / 100 |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"`high` is the default ceiling. V4.1-Flash drives effort from an internal 1–100 scalar and exposes
th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ree preset names; `high` corresponds to roughly 75, which is where the published effort curve is
sti"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ll steep. Pushing past it costs about 1.6–1.8x the output tokens for a marginal gain."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Since v0.15.0 `routes.<class>.effort` accepts any of the nine effort words (`off`, `none`, `minimal`"},{"id":"p9s2","text":", `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`, `ultra`); a target that does not know a word gets the nea"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"rest tier, breaking ties upward (quality first). `off` and the max-class words still go through rule"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"g ties upward (quality first). `off` and the max-class words still go through rule 5 and `allowMax`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Authorization scopes, the model pool and task presets (v0.5)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`control` decides what the router owns, and a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it: an
"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"effort change stands down `full`/`effort` but not `model`, and a model switch stands down
`full`/`mo"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"del` but not `effort`. While the router is down it stays out until the next command or the
composer "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"control's **resume** action."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Scope | Owns |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `full` — 模型+思考 / Model+Effort | model + reasoning effort |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What 1.0.0 actually promises (v1.0.0)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A 1.0 is a promise about what will not break, so this version is mostly about making the existing
su"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rface legible rather than adding capability."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **A versioned envelope.** Every HTTP response from the panel's router — including the 403, 405 and"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"
400 answers produced by the transport — now carries `"schemaVersion": 1`. A reader can refuse an
en"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"velope it does not understand instead of guessing; `docs/api.md` documents the sixteen routes and
th"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"e module entry points published through `package.json#exports`.
- **The contract is tested, not just"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" described.** `test/contract.test.js` fails if `docs/api.md` and
the registered routes disagree, if "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"a host event the plugin listens to is missing from
`docs/compat.md`, if an export stops resolving or"},{"id":"p16s7","text":" escapes the published directories, or if a
response ever loses its `schemaVersion`.
- **Degradation"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" is named.** `/state.compat` reports `missing` (a capability without which routing
cannot run, today"},{"id":"p16s9","text":" only `sessionProjections`) and `optional` (`webServer`, `commands`, `llm`). The
panel renders a not"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"e listing what is missing in the chat language, so a host that is too old shows
as a shortcoming ins"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"tead of looking fine while features silently do nothing.
- **An upgrade path with no migration.** `d"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"ocs/migration-0.14-to-1.0.md` lists every configuration key
added since 0.14.2, notes that nothing n"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"eeds migrating (the state file is read as-is), and records
the one default that changed shape: `peak"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"Policy` starts at `inform`, which only ever prints.
- **Additive within 1.x.** Modules may gain expo"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"rts and `/state` may gain fields in a minor release;
removing or repurposing either waits for 2.0. `"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"PUBLISHING.md` covers the mechanics, `CONTRIBUTING.md`
the checks a change must pass, and `SECURITY."},{"id":"p16s17","text":"md` what the plugin stores and what it never reads."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Deliberately not in this version: splitting the browser bundle into a build artifact, and a CI matri"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"x
against two host versions. Both are infrastructure work that does not change what the router decid"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"es,
and both are recorded as deferred in `PLAN.md` rather than implied by the version number."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Requirements and compatibility"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Node 20 or newer.
- `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.2.0`; tested on `@deepseek-ai/ds"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"h` 0.1.7-rc.2.
The plugin uses `agent/request`, `agent/inbox/claimed`, `session.deriveMessages()` an"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"d the
session projections (`modelSelection`, `todos`, `contextPressure`, `tokenUsage`).
- **Do not**"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" declare `@deepseek-ai/*` `peerDependencies` in the plugin root. The host boot gate only
reads peerD"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ependencies and silently skips a plugin it cannot resolve instead of failing; `engines.dsh`
is used "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"by dshmarket for install-time compatibility only and does not affect boot. The runtime
defence is th"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"e startup self-check planned for 0.15+ (a missing contract switches to degraded and
says so in the p"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"anel).
- Only the web composer seat (`conversation.input.model`) is verified; when the host does not"},{"id":"p19s9","text":" declare
that seat the panel falls back to the `conversation.input.right` chip."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **No config schema.** Settings are read from the profile patch layer shown above and do not render"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"
as a form in the settings UI. This is deliberate: a schema would require importing
`@deepseek-ai/*`"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" packages, which a plugin installed beside the profile cannot resolve.
- The router only touches the"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" `deepseek-official` provider and models matching `familyPattern`.
- **The router control takes over"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" the official model cell by registration, not by patching the
component.** It registers into `conver"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"sation.input.model` at priority -1 (below the shipped
`ModelSelect` at 0), keeping the official mode"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"l + effort sections inside its own panel. The old
`conversation.input.right` chip (`model-router:com"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"poser-control`, order 20) self-retracts and is only
a fallback for a host that rejects the seat. 0.1"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"0.0's first attempt shipped a blank cell and was
rolled back in 0.10.1 because it had not declared `"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"sessions` / `remote` / `remote.session` on the
plugin root.
- **The per-call route line is a separat"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"e small row** anchored after the tool call, not a badge inside
the harness's own tool row or inside "},{"id":"p21s12","text":"the thinking chain: a keyed slot replaces whatever it targets,
and the thinking chain exposes no chi"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"ld slot. A call the host has not folded yet shows nothing
rather than guessing. Plugin source change"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"s only appear after you restart `dsh web`."}],"truncated":true}
